title: Monitoring + alerting for PLG→Sales signal pipeline (volume, HubSpot writes, latency)
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Goal
Build production monitoring + alerting for the PLG→Sales signal pipeline so we can detect:
- signal volume anomalies (silent drop / runaway spam)
- HubSpot write failures (rate limits, auth errors, payload validation issues)
- end-to-end latency regressions (event ingestion → aggregation → scoring → HubSpot timeline event/task)

Context
This pipeline directly drives outbound tasks/sequences. Failure modes are high-risk in two ways:
1) missed high-intent accounts (lost pipeline)
2) duplicate/noisy signals causing duplicate outreach (trust + brand damage)

Scope (v1)
1) Dashboards
A) "PLG Signal Pipeline Overview" (primary oncall dashboard)
- Ingestion rate (events/min) by event_type (pricing_page_view, contact_sales, security_docs_view, rate_limit_hit, routing_failure, etc.)
- Aggregated signal candidates generated (counts) by signal_type and tier/segment
- Scored signal emits (counts) by signal_type + feature flag state (on/off)
- Dedupe outcomes: emitted vs dropped_due_to_dedupe vs dropped_due_to_suppression vs dropped_due_to_cooldown
- HubSpot writes: success_count, failure_count, retry_count
- Slack notifications: sent_count, suppressed_count, failures

B) "HubSpot Writer Health"
- Requests/min + batch size distribution
- Error rates by HTTP code (429, 401/403, 5xx, 4xx validation)
- Retry/backoff metrics (attempt histogram)
- Dead-letter queue (DLQ) depth + oldest message age
- Idempotency conflict rate (if applicable)

C) "Latency & Freshness"
- End-to-end lag p50/p95/p99 (telemetry_event_time → hubspot_write_time)
- Component lag: aggregation job freshness (window refresh delay), scoring job delay, writer delay
- Backfill runs: duration, rows processed, error count

2) Alerting (PagerDuty for eng-oncall; Slack for noise-only)
P1 paging alerts (actionable, indicates outage/major degradation)
- HubSpot writer sustained failure rate > 2% for 10m (excluding 429 where retries succeed; see note)
- HubSpot auth failures (401/403) > 0 for 5m
- DLQ depth > 500 OR oldest message age > 30m
- End-to-end lag p95 > 60m for 30m
- Signal emission drops to ~0 for key signal types ("contact sales", "security intent", "sustained spend") for 30m during business hours (guarded by expected baseline)

P2 non-paging alerts (triage during biz hours; post to #eng-platform + #sales-ops)
- Volume anomaly: spike > 3x 7-day baseline for any signal_type for 30m (potential dedupe regression / spam)
- Dedupe drop rate increases > 2x baseline for 1h (may indicate key change causing duplicates)
- HubSpot 429 rate limit: sustained > 10% for 30m (tune batching/backoff or workflow throttles)
- Slack notifier failures > 1% for 30m (if enabled)

Notes / design considerations
- Baselines: use a trailing 7d baseline by signal_type + environment; minimum floor to avoid false positives on low-volume signals.
- Business hours: volume-drop alerts should be business-hour gated (Mon–Fri, 8am–6pm local for NA primarily) to reduce noise; still keep DLQ/auth alerts 24/7.
- Rate limit handling: 429s are expected; alert only when they cause write failures / DLQ growth / lag.
- Suppression/opt-out: ensure monitoring distinguishes "suppressed by rule" vs "failed" so Sales doesn’t interpret suppression as outages.

Implementation plan
- Instrumentation: ensure each stage emits structured metrics (counters + histograms + gauges). Confirm metric names/labels are stable and low-cardinality.
- Dashboarding: add dashboards to the shared Observability pack so they’re versioned.
- Alert rules: define in the same repo as other platform alerts; route P1 to Eng Oncall (Platform) with tag "plg-signals".
- Runbook links: every alert must link to a runbook section with:
  - how to confirm the issue (queries / dashboards)
  - common causes
  - safe remediation steps
  - escalation path (Biz Systems / Sales Ops / Security)

Runbooks
- Link primary runbook: sources/confluence/eng-platform/runbooks/plg-signal-routing-runbook.json
- Add sections for:
  - HubSpot writer rate limits + auth issues
  - backfill + replay from DLQ
  - dedupe regressions (idempotency key changes)
  - verifying end-to-end delivery in HubSpot (timeline event + task creation)

Acceptance criteria
- Dashboards A/B/C exist in prod and are discoverable under "GTM Integrations" folder.
- P1 alerts page correctly with runbook links and have been test-fired in staging.
- Alert noise audit: during pilot week, < 2 non-actionable pages.
- Oncall can validate a signal end-to-end in < 10 minutes using dashboards + runbook.

Out of scope (v1)
- Per-account anomaly detection (too high cardinality; revisit later)
- Automated remediation (e.g., auto-disable signal types) — handled via ENG-2846 kill switch/feature flags.

Rollout / testing
- Stage alert rules in staging for 48h.
- During pilot: add a daily health check summary posted to #eng-platform (optional) showing lag + error rates.

Owners / reviewers
- Owner: Rafael Mendes
- Metrics/dashboards: Allison Grant (review)
- Pipeline owners for instrumentation coordination: Logan Wright, Nadia Rahman
- HubSpot admin contact for auth/rate limit changes: David Kim
comments: 2025-02-12 (Rafael Mendes): Drafted initial metric list. Biggest open question: do we have reliable event timestamps through the writer for true end-to-end lag, or do we need to add an explicit `original_event_time` to the scored signal payload? Looping in Logan/Nadia.

2025-02-13 (Nadia Rahman): We have `ingest_time` and `event_time` for telemetry. Scoring emits `scored_at`. Writer currently logs `write_at` but not exposing as metric label; can add histogram `signal_pipeline_end_to_end_lag_seconds` computed at writer using `event_time` carried forward. Please avoid adding user IDs as labels.

2025-02-18 (Allison Grant): Please keep dashboards aligned to our standard: overview (RED), dependencies (queues), and saturation. For anomaly alerts, prefer baseline compare + minimum volume threshold to avoid paging on low-volume signal types.
2025-02-20 (Logan Wright): Added counters for dedupe outcomes in scoring service. Writer exposes per-status code counts and retry attempts. DLQ depth metric is available via queue exporter.
2025-02-26 (Rafael Mendes): Implemented dashboards + alert rules in observability-pack. Added runbook deep links for each alert. Test-fired HubSpot auth alert in staging by rotating key.

2025-03-04 (David Kim): Confirmed HubSpot rate limits: we’ll see occasional 429s at peak; alerting should key off DLQ age / lag rather than raw 429 count. Also added note: auth failures usually happen after secret rotation.
2025-03-06 (Rafael Mendes): Merged + deployed. Confirmed dashboard data in prod. Paging alerts enabled for Platform oncall; non-paging go to #eng-platform and #sales-ops.
